profile.headline: Software Developer at Yellowstone Landscape | Creating Delightful Technical Experiences in the Landscaping Industry
profile.summary: Digital Literacy should never be a barrier in being able to access, apply and maximize technology in the day to day workflows that keep businesses running. Technology should be designed to work for the end user, meeting them where they are at in a way that is easy to understand. That’s why I’m currently building resilient AI Integrations and automated workflows to reduce friction so that landscaping leaders are able to focus on what they do best: connecting with customers and building relationships.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Built integrations with third-party services and APIs using Python to automate back-end workflows critical for reporting and data synthesis 
- Experimented with Agentic AI to streamline manual reporting, documentation, and communication processes, allowing for quicker decision making and recommendations

positions.title: Junior Software Developer
positions.description:
- Maintained ETLs, supporting Data Engineer with data synthesis and on-demand reporting
- Collaborated with Data Engineer to optimize documentation processes through leading Front-end development using Expo, TypeScript, and TailwindCSS, delivering the first internal mobile application.

positions.title: Content Creator Manager
positions.description:
- Developed workflows to increase efficiency in filtering Content Creators who expressed interest in joining the organization and subsequent on-boarding process. 
- Integrated Trello as a tool for CEO and COO to manage project planning and deadlines.
- Collaborated with the Social Media Manager to develop and implement marketing campaign schedules for events
- Managed and moderated Team Inferno's Tournament discord of over 1000+ members.
positions.insights: Skills: Customer Service · Business Strategy · Leadership · Event Planning · Event Management

positions.title: Product Specialist
positions.description:
- Troubleshooted minor software and product issues before escalating to Genius Bar if issue was too complex. 
- Completed transactions and returns using Apple's customized POS system, EasyPay. 
- Applied knowledge about Apple technology and services to engage guests and create customized solutions to their technical needs.
positions.insights: Skills: Customer Service · Software Troubleshooting · Writing · Problem Solving · Technical Support · Analytical Skills

positions.title: Case Manager
positions.description:
- Incorporated strengths-focused practices to advocate for clients within Targeted Case Management program. 
- Researched community resources and connected clients according to self-identified needs. 
- Conducted intake interviews and needs analysis to determine effective Service Plan to meet client's needs.
- Utilized Optum to request Medicaid and Medicare coverage approval quarterly
- Documented client interactions utilizing in-house documentation system
positions.insights: Skills: Nonprofit Organizations · Case Management · Writing · Problem Solving · Analytical Skills

positions.title: Intensive Advocacy Service Learning Fellow
positions.description: Provided intensive advocacy and case management services to over 30 youth and families in the Prince George’s County area, services included daily home visits, 24/7 crisis intervention, assistance in completion of probation requirements, informal counseling and mediation.
positions.insights: Skills: Case Management · Child Advocacy · Social Justice · Restorative Justice

projects.title: Bookhood
projects.description:
Designed a book-tracking application that allows users to create personalized book lists

- Assessed competitor designs and market strategies to enhance user interface design
- Applied Mobile-first design and SOLID principles to develop a scalable application with password and email user authentication

projects.title: The Key Shop
projects.description:
Developed a responsive E-Commerce website for users to view keyboard products, filter products by type, add and delete products from their shopping cart

- Analyzed popular websites Cannonkeys, Novelkeys, and Osume to design web and mobile layouts in Figma 
- Translated design layouts to code using TailwindCSS, focusing on the mobile responsiveness of products and home page
